notes: Scan 114, author page 56, carries a running continuation. The top note reads ceci marche au moins dans le Contexte des espaces analytiques: Contexte has an extended multi-letter body, and espaces is written out. The stray main-text est visible at the edge of its rotated crop is excluded from the note.

Scan 114, S114-01: the opening calls the preceding morphism a mono, with an analytic-space qualification in the margin. The actual definition of that earlier morphism is outside this packet; its analytic monicity was carried as background, not proved or checked here.

Scan 114, S114-02: the determination of (167) by its composite with the asserted monomorphism (168) was checked only as a conditional uniqueness claim. If m is monic and m f = m g, cancellation gives f = g. This proves neither existence of (167), monicity of the displayed earlier map, nor the content of the heavily rewritten reference (166).

Scan 114, S114-03: the composition-domain typing was checked locally. Write O = D_* and A = D_{**}. The source label is sigma and the target label is b. The fibre product (A,b) times_O (A,sigma) imposes b(u) = sigma(v), which is the condition for the written order v composed with u. This is only a typing check; no existence or analyticity of the composition morphism was proved.

Scan 114, S114-04: the last sentence invokes the usual associativity and unit axioms and continues onto another leaf. These axioms and the analytic internal-category structure are recorded as manuscript claims/definition data. Their satisfaction is not verified by this transcription or by the limited typing check.

The final digits of the references (167) and (168) are retraced; the earlier digit under either is not recoverable enough to transcribe separately. The last digit in (166) is still doubtful. No earlier numeral has been invented from the apparent order of the references.

The small parenthesis below the underlined title is spatially interlinear. It is retained with the margin-note convention, with its actual location stated in the inventory; it is not an extra main-title clause. The separate d'abord insertion attaches between se définit and comme. The higher multiplicité was inserted before analytique and then cancelled.

The identity word has an overtraced terminal cluster with a descender, so identique is ranked first while identité remains an alternative. A separate earlier suffix or a clear cancellation boundary cannot be isolated. The entire word remains doubtful.

The cancelled token before ces données is very short and is represented as doubtful tt; no expansion to Toutes is made in the transcription. The pale grey strokes intersecting the region of exprimant differ in tone and line width from the dark authored baseline and do not yield a separate word. They are treated as non-text incidental marks, without attributing a cause such as bleed-through.

All quotation marks are represented as paired ticks, as drawn. The second D_{**} row has an actual long repetition stroke, retained as a rule. The single brace of (169) spans all the listed data. The line count is 19 principal text/display baselines, with marginal and interlinear material inventoried separately. All fourteen generated crops were opened and visually inspected; no OCR, external page, or TeX compilation was used.
